titles.native: 映画 ふしぎ駄菓子屋 銭天堂 つりたい焼き

description:
Zenitendou is a mysterious candy store that only lucky people can reach. All the candy recommended by Beniko, the owner of the store, is perfectly suited to the buyer's troubles. However, it depends on whether the candy will be used or eaten correctly that it can bring happiness or misfortune.

Our lucky customer this time is Keiji, an 8-year-old boy who loves fishing. He gets a "Tsuri Taiyaki," a mysterious candy that allows him to catch taiyaki, and starts fishing with excitement...
Note: Screened at the 2020 Toei Manga Festival. Originally scheduled for April 24, but postponed due to the COVID pandemic.
